summary: DOE eXCHANGE is an ASP.NET page that embeds its full opportunity list as inline JSON (dbFOAList plus dbfoaListDetails with deadlines). The html adapter cannot read it (24 MB, timeout). The existing grants_gov adapter, given the DOE sub-agency codes joined with a pipe, returns 15 live DOE calls with deadlines and passes adapter_check today. Recommended now: grants_gov config above. Better long term: a new embedded_json adapter for eXCHANGE (covers NOI, RFI, Lab Call, teaming lists that Grants.gov does not carry); its prototype reads the page live with plain HTTP.
engine_requirements: Option A (use now, no engine change): adapter grants_gov, adapter_config {agencies: DOE-GFO|DOE-ARPAE|DOE-ID|DOE-NETL|PAMS-SC, oppStatuses: forecasted|posted, rows: 100}. Gaps: DOE parent code returns 0, so every sub-agency must be listed; CMEI/OE/OTC/CESER eXCHANGE-only items (NOI, RFI, LC, teaming lists) are not on Grants.gov. Option B (new adapter, embedded_json): GET https://exchange.energy.gov/Default.aspx (plain, no cookies, browser UA); locate the literal text const dbFOAList = [ and const dbfoaListDetails = [; bracket-match to the closing ] (string-aware) and JSON.parse each; index every object with ; replace {:N} with the indexed object; dedupe by FoaId; keep AnnouncementStatus==Open AND ApprovedForPublic==true AND Archived==false AND IsDeleted==false (do NOT require Published, it is False for 99 of 100 open rows); external_id=FoaNumber; title=FoaTitle; type=FOATypeName; deadline = min of FullAppSubmissionDeadline, ConceptPaperUpldDeadline, SubmissionRegistrationDeadline from dbfoaListDetails rows with the same FoaId (ISO datetime, take first 10 chars); status=open only if deadline is null or >= today, else closed; url=https://exchange.energy.gov/FAQ.aspx?FoaId=<FoaId>. Engine risk: 24.6 MB response and ~21 MB JSON, roughly 35 s per fetch from this machine; the edge function needs a streaming or slice-first parse (bracket-match before JSON.parse) and a 150 s wall-clock budget. Lower-risk alternative: only parse dbFOAList slice.
